scope: Synthetic Rule contract integrity, not real-person or empirical voting scoring

A.estimand: valid-rule input contract enforced at creation, stability of same rule object under caller mutation

hypotheses: Shallow @dataclass(frozen=True) leaves nested mappings mutable and arbitrary weights/caps accepted
Rule effectively immutable with valid fields
Rules invalid only raise on scoring instead of at construction

positive_controls: unchanged DEMO_RULE yields 2.0 for one synthetic event
zero cap is valid and disables counted kind
